dialogues.speaker: Jawahir
dialogues.text: I'm the owner of this store, of course. I sell hand-crafted goods, mostly thin blankets, clothes and some other odds and ends.

dialogues.speaker: Jawahir
dialogues.text: When I was young, I worked at the carpet shop in the city... Never thought I'd be using my skills even now!

dialogues.speaker: Jawahir
dialogues.text: Not that I hope to make too much Mora this way, but I do hope to make others' lives better.

dialogues.speaker: Jawahir
dialogues.text: That said, I haven't been back to the city for a long time, so I have no clue if these designs are still in style.

dialogues.speaker: Jawahir
dialogues.text: But people old and young like my handiwork, so I suppose it's fine!
